"Rappy Twinkle":
"Rappy Twinkle is an object that can be obtained by spending Exploration Points earned during Quests. Obtaining Rappy Twinkle increases a multiplier on the amount of points you earn for defeating enemies.
\u3000\u3000
There are 3 types of Rappy Twinkle: 〇, ▽ and □. You cannot collect Rappy Twinkle of a type that you already possess until you have collected all 3 types."
"Collecting all 3 types of Rappy Twinkle gives you a chance to earn Exploration Points. The amount you earn is randomly determined, so if you're lucky, you might get a lot!"
